assertions.subject: Tricuspid Regurgitation
assertions.quote: Dilatation of the right atrium and the right ventricle, along with dilatation of the tricuspid annulus and tethering of the tricuspid valve leaflet, are some of the causes of secondary tricuspid regurgitation.
